notes.title: New Art Coming to Squid Grid!
notes.content:
Hello Squids,

We would like to welcome our new artist Dan Gartman to the Squid Grid Team! You can find his work in the games TOHU and Under What?. 

Dan is hard at work to completely transform the art with hand-drawn animations in an immersive Steampunk world. 

Take a look at the progress:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962793/ece14ce66289f70a77278b5cec90998c7e46a1e5.png

Please join our Discord for more frequent updates and play-testing opportunities. 

Thank you for your support,

-The Squid Grid Team
